detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

CJC-1295 (with DAC) / Ipamorelin – Peptide Blend

Chemical Information:
  • CJC-1295 (with DAC)
    • Molecular Formula: C165H271N47O46
    • Molecular Weight: 3647 Da
    • Sequence: Tyr-D-Ala-Asp-Ala-Ile-Phe-Thr-Gln-Ser-Tyr-Arg-Lys-Val-Leu-Ala-Gln-Leu-Ser-Ala-Arg-Lys-Leu-Leu-Gln-Asp-Ile-Met-Leu-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys-Lys-Ser
    • Structure Class: Synthetic peptide with DAC modification
  • Ipamorelin
    • Molecular Formula: C38H49N9O5
    • Molecular Weight: 711.86 Da
    • Sequence: Aib-His-D-2-Nal-D-Phe-Lys-NH2
    • Structure Class: Synthetic pentapeptide
Product Description:

This research blend consists of two structurally defined synthetic peptides: CJC-1295 (with DAC) and Ipamorelin. Each component is produced through controlled peptide synthesis and combined in a standardized formulation for use in laboratory research environments. The blend is utilized in controlled experimental settings for analytical evaluation of peptide behavior, stability, and interaction within defined systems. All applications are limited to in vitro research models. The product is supplied in lyophilized powder form to support stability and integrity during storage and handling.

Research Applications:

This peptide blend is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide structure and sequence characteristics
  • Examination of stability and degradation profiles of combined peptide systems
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and cell-based assay environments
  • Characterization of interactions between peptide components under controlled experimental conditions
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at -20°C.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2–8°C and use promptly.
  • Maintain aseptic technique during laboratory handling.
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

This peptide blend is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
